title: Security & Billing Verification
objective: Menguji OAuth, token storage, API keys, sessions, permissions, webhook authenticity, entitlement, payment redirects, and audit.

buckets.note: AccountOAuthFlow (115.11) re-verified live: S256 challenge derived from the verifier, callback state consumed once, nonce compared in constant time when the connector requires it. Live provider token exchange and revocation stay DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

AccountSecureTokenVault re-verified live: a refused reauthentication returns null and writes nothing, and an account id containing '/' is rejected so a key cannot be written outside the account namespace.

DEFECT FIXED THIS STEP. replace() overwrote vault key material with reauthentication refused (probe: reauth=false -> read=rotated). It now refuses, leaves the secret untouched, and records denied_replace. The product spec lists reveal_or_replace_key under security_contract.sensitive_actions.

AccountCenterSessionDeviceManagement re-verified live: the current session is never revoked from the list, force logout needs explicit confirmation and keeps the current session active, and a suspicious session must be revoked before it can be trusted. Live identity-provider revocation propagation stays DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

AccountCenterWorkspaceBoundaryContract re-verified live against security_contract.cross_workspace_rule: Novel/Character data is denied without an explicit permission, a cross-scope transfer is denied without consent, and an ACCOUNT_GLOBAL backup boundary holding workspaces/novels data is a violation.

CAPABILITY ADDED THIS STEP. No webhook verification existed anywhere under lib/features/account (rg for webhook/hmac/replay returned zero matches), so a provider callback was trusted unconditionally. verifyWebhook now checks an HMAC-SHA256 over a versioned v1:<timestamp>:<body> payload in constant time, enforces a declared tolerance window, and refuses a repeated delivery id.

DEFECT FIXED THIS STEP. entitlementStateAt compared only expiresAt, so a grant issued 2026-10-01 evaluated at 2020-01-01 returned granted (probe: state_at_2020=granted). The new EntitlementState.notYetIssued closes the window at both ends, and the right rail counts it separately instead of as granted.

AccountCenterActivityAuditOverview re-verified live: declaring a sensitive key that is not present in the details is a construction error rather than a silent no-op, a redacted value never appears in toPublicJson, and an event older than the retention window is not retained.

defects_fixed: entitlementStateAt compared only expiresAt, so an entitlement was reported as granted at any instant before it was issued; the new EntitlementState.notYetIssued closes the window at both ends and the right rail counts it separately.

AccountCenterApiKeysManager.replace overwrote vault key material with reauthentication refused, contradicting security_contract.sensitive_actions (reveal_or_replace_key); it now refuses, leaves the secret untouched, and audits denied_replace.
The canonical webhook_tests bucket named a capability that did not exist under lib/features/account; verifyWebhook now provides signature, tolerance, and replay checks.
deferred_external: Live OAuth token exchange and revocation against a real identity provider (no provider HTTP client exists under lib/features/account).
Live payment-provider redirects, checkout sessions, and PCI certification; billing_contract.status remains PLANNED_NOT_VERIFIED.
Live identity-provider session inventory and revocation propagation.
Hosted CI, public-trust signing, telemetry, hardware, adoption, and publication gates.
overlap_note: vault_tests and key_tests both exercise AccountSecureTokenVault, and key_tests drives AccountCenterApiKeysManager which stores through that same vault; their evidence overlaps by design and must not be summed. permission_tests and audit_tests both read the workspace boundary and the audit redaction rule respectively, which are also covered by the 115.4 and 115.31 manifests.
